search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/windows-jsonformat  "\"Channel\":\"Security\"" ("\"EventID\":\"4727\"" or "\"EventID\":\"4731\"" or "\"EventID\":\"4754\"")  _sourceName=Security
| json "EventID", "Computer", "Message", "EventData.SubjectUserName", "EventData.SubjectDomainName", "EventData.TargetUserName", "EventData.TargetDomainName", "Channel" as event_id, host, msg_summary, src_user, src_domain, dest_user, dest_domain, channel nodrop
| parse regex field=msg_summary "(?<msg_summary>.*\.*)" nodrop
| where event_id in ("4727", "4731", "4754")
| dest_user as group_name | dest_domain as group_domain
| fields host, event_id, msg_summary, src_user, src_domain, group_name, group_domain
